from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path)
ws = wb.active
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames, "| Active:", ws.title, "| dims:", ws.max_row, "x", ws.max_column)

def norm(v):
    return str(v).strip().lower() if v is not None else ""

rev_keys = ["revenue", "sales", "turnover", "gross"]
prof_keys = ["profit", "net income", "earnings"]
cost_keys = ["cost", "cogs", "expense"]

header_row = rev_col = prof_col = cost_col = None
for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row, 10) + 1):
    vals = [norm(ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value) for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)]
    if not any(vals):
        continue
    rv = next((c for c, v in enumerate(vals, 1) if any(k in v for k in rev_keys)), None)
    pv = next((c for c, v in enumerate(vals, 1) if any(k in v for k in prof_keys)), None)
    cv = next((c for c, v in enumerate(vals, 1) if any(k in v for k in cost_keys)), None)
    if rv is not None and (pv is not None or cv is not None):
        header_row, rev_col, prof_col, cost_col = r, rv, pv, cv
        break

if header_row is None:
    raise SystemExit("Could not locate revenue + profit/cost header columns")

last_data = header_row
for r in range(header_row + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
    if any(ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value not in (None, "") for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)):
        last_data = r

def col_letter(i):
    s = ""
    while i:
        i, rem = divmod(i - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + rem) + s
    return s

if prof_col:
    prof_ref = "{L}{r}".format(L=col_letter(prof_col), r="{r}")
else:
    prof_ref = "({L}{r}-{C}{r})".format(L=col_letter(rev_col), C=col_letter(cost_col), r="{r}")
rev_ref = "{L}{r}".format(L=col_letter(rev_col), r="{r}")

new_col = ws.max_column + 1
new_letter = col_letter(new_col)
hdr = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=new_col, value="Profit Margin %")
hdr.font = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=rev_col).font

for r in range(header_row + 1, last_data + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=new_col)
    cell.value = ('=IF(OR({rev}="",{prof}=""),"",'
                  'IF({rev}=0,0,{prof}/{rev}))').format(rev=rev_ref.format(r=r), prof=prof_ref.format(r=r))
    cell.number_format = '0.0%;-0.0%;"-"'

wb.save(path)
print("Header row:", header_row)
print("Revenue col:", col_letter(rev_col), "| Profit col:", col_letter(prof_col) if prof_col else "none (using rev-cost)", "| Cost col:", col_letter(cost_col) if cost_col else "none")
print("New column:", new_letter, "| header: Profit Margin % | rows:", header_row + 1, "to", last_data)
print("Sample formula (row", header_row + 1, "):", ws.cell(row=header_row + 1, column=new_col).value)

import zipfile
import re
import shutil
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
ET.register_namespace('m', M)
ET.register_namespace('r', R)

try:
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("FILE_MISSING:", path)
    raise SystemExit(1)

print("ENTRIES:")
for n in z.namelist():
    print(" ", n)

wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
sheets = wb_root.find('m:sheets', {'m': M})
sheet_list = list(sheets)
view = wb_root.find('m:bookViews/m:workbookView', {'m': M})
active_tab = int(view.get('activeTab')) if view is not None and view.get('activeTab') else 0
print("ACTIVE_TAB:", active_tab)
for i, s in enumerate(sheet_list):
    print("  sheet", i, "name=%r" % s.get('name'), "rid=%s" % s.get('{%s}id' % R))

rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rid_map = {rel.get('Id'): rel.get('Target') for rel in rels}
sel = sheet_list[active_tab]
target = rid_map[sel.get('{%s}id' % R)]
if not target.startswith('xl/'):
    target = 'xl/' + target
print("USING_SHEET:", target)

sx_root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
sd = sx_root.find('m:sheetData', {'m': M})
rows = sd.findall('m:row', {'m': M})
print("ROWS:", len(rows), "max_row:", max((int(r.get('r', 0)) for r in rows), default=0))

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    ss = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in ss.findall('m:si', {'m': M}):
        txt = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t' % M))
        shared.append(txt)
print("SHARED_STRINGS:", len(shared))


def cell_val(c):
    t = c.get('t')
    v = c.find('m:v', {'m': M})
    raw = v.text if v is not None else None
    if t == 's' and raw is not None:
        return shared[int(raw)]
    if t == 'inlineStr':
        return ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in c.iter('{%s}t' % M))
    return raw


def col_num(ref):
    n = 0
    for ch in re.match(r'[A-Z]+', ref).group(0):
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return n


max_col = 0
for r in rows[:6]:
    rn = int(r.get('r'))
    cells = []
    for c in r.findall('m:c', {'m': M}):
        ref = c.get('r')
        if not ref:
            continue
        max_col = max(max_col, col_num(ref))
        f = c.find('m:f', {'m': M})
        cells.append((ref, c.get('t'), cell_val(c), (f.text if f is not None else None)))
    print(" row", rn, "->", cells)

print("MAX_COL_HEADER:", max_col)
print("STYLES_PRESENT:", 'xl/styles.xml' in z.namelist())
if 'xl/styles.xml' in z.namelist():
    st = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/styles.xml'))
    cellxfs = st.find('m:cellXfs', {'m': M})
    numfmts = st.find('m:numFmts', {'m': M})
    print(" cellXfs count attr:", cellxfs.get('count'), "actual:", len(cellxfs))
    print(" numFmts:", numfmts.get('count') if numfmts is not None else None)
    print(" first cellXfs:", [(x.get('numFmtId'), x.get('applyNumberFormat')) for x in cellxfs[:4]])
print("SOFFICE:", shutil.which('soffice'))
